    61  
    62  /-- The normalized Moore complex in degree `n`, as a subobject of `X n`.
    63  -/
    64  def objX : ∀ n : ℕ, Subobject (X.obj (op ⦋n⦌))
    65    | 0 => ⊤
    66    | n + 1 => Finset.univ.inf fun k : Fin (n + 1) => kernelSubobject (X.δ k.succ)
    67  
    68  @[simp] theorem objX_zero : objX X 0 = ⊤ :=
    69    rfl
    70  
    71  @[simp] theorem objX_add_one (n) :
    72      objX X (n + 1) = Finset.univ.inf fun k : Fin (n + 1) => kernelSubobject (X.δ k.succ) :=
    73    rfl
    74  
    75  set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
    76  /-- The differentials in the normalized Moore complex.
    77  -/
    78  @[simp]
    79  def objD : ∀ n : ℕ, (objX X (n + 1) : C) ⟶ (objX X n : C)
    80    | 0 => Subobject.arrow _ ≫ X.δ (0 : Fin 2) ≫ inv (⊤ : Subobject _).arrow
    81    | n + 1 => by
    82      -- The differential is `Subobject.arrow _ ≫ X.δ (0 : Fin (n+3))`,
    83      -- factored through the intersection of the kernels.
    84      refine factorThru _ (arrow _ ≫ X.δ (0 : Fin (n + 3))) ?_
    85      -- We now need to show that it factors!
    86      -- A morphism factors through an intersection of subobjects if it factors through each.
    87      refine (finset_inf_factors _).mpr fun i _ => ?_
    88      -- A morphism `f` factors through the kernel of `g` exactly if `f ≫ g = 0`.
    89      apply kernelSubobject_factors
    90      dsimp [objX]

    94      -- of a morphism we don't care about with the arrow out of the kernel of `X.δ i.succ.succ`.
    95      rw [← factorThru_arrow _ _ (finset_inf_arrow_factors Finset.univ _ i.succ (by simp)),
